title: Vehicle habitation ban (SDMC 86.0137(f)) enjoined
description: Federal judge Anthony Battaglia issues a preliminary injunction in Bloom v. City of San Diego (17-cv-2324-AJB-NLS) halting enforcement of SDMC 86.0137(f) (living in a vehicle parked on street) as unconstitutionally vague and arbitrarily enforced -- explains why vehicle-habitation citations in source D stop after 2018.

title: City Council repeals vehicle habitation ban language
description: Council votes to repeal the habitation-ban portion of SDMC 86.0137 following the 2018 federal injunction and the 9th Circuit's Desertrain v. City of Los Angeles precedent on vague vehicle-dwelling ordinances.

title: New Vehicle Habitation Ordinance (VHO) adopted
description: City Council approves a replacement emergency ordinance restricting vehicle habitation within 500 feet of a school or residence and citywide between 9pm-6am.

title: Unsafe Camping Ordinance adopted
description: City Council approves a ban on tent encampments on public property in an initial 5-4 vote (final approval June 27; signed by Mayor Gloria June 29).

title: First Safe Sleeping Site opens (20th & B)
description: City's first Safe Sleeping Program site opens to clients at the Central Operations Yard (20th & B streets Golden Hill); ~136 tent spaces operated by Dreams for Change.

title: Unsafe Camping Ordinance enforcement begins
description: SDPD begins progressive enforcement of the camping ban starting near schools and parks; sources differ slightly on whether the very first enforcement action fell on Sun Jul 30 or Mon Jul 31 2023.

title: O Lot Safe Sleeping Site opens near Balboa Park
description: Second Safe Sleeping site opens near the Naval Medical Center east of Nursery Road with roughly 400 tent spaces expanding the city's Safe Sleeping Program.

title: SDPD resumes full VHO enforcement after settlement
description: Following the ~$3.2M Bloom v. City of San Diego settlement setting new enforcement rules, SDPD begins officer training to resume full Vehicle Habitation Ordinance enforcement.

title: Golden Hall shelter closes
description: City's largest downtown shelter (264 beds) closes after intake had already stopped earlier in the year; remaining residents relocated to other shelters/Safe Sleeping sites.
